SELECT count(*) AS n, count(DISTINCT sales_line_id) AS d_id, count(DISTINCT (receipt_id, line_no)) AS d_rl,
       min(sale_date) AS mn, max(sale_date) AS mx, count(DISTINCT etl_loaded_at) AS loads,
       min(etl_loaded_at) AS first_load, max(etl_loaded_at) AS last_load,
       sum(CASE WHEN gross_amount < net_amount THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS gross_lt_net,
       sum(CASE WHEN abs(gross_amount - net_amount*(1+vat_rate)) > 0.02 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS vat_mismatch
FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-07-25' AND DATE '2024-10-05'

WITH d AS (
  SELECT d.calendar_date, d.is_trading_day, d.holiday_name,
         count(f.sales_line_id) AS lines, count(DISTINCT s.store_id) AS stores
  FROM dim_date d
  LEFT JOIN fact_sales_line f ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
  LEFT JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key AND s.store_id < 900
  WHERE d.calendar_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-01' AND DATE '2024-09-30'
  GROUP BY 1,2,3)
SELECT * FROM d WHERE lines < 1500 OR NOT is_trading_day OR stores < 28 ORDER BY 1

WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id, status,
           CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order
),
lines AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, f.sale_date, s.store_id, s.region,
           f.gross_amount, w.status, f.channel_code
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
      AND (f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-07-20' AND DATE '2024-10-10')
)
SELECT region, store_id = 900 AS is_web, status, channel_code,
       sum(CASE WHEN business_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-01' AND DATE '2024-08-31' THEN gross_amount END) AS aug_bd,
       sum(CASE WHEN business_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-09-01' AND DATE '2024-09-30' THEN gross_amount END) AS sep_bd,
       sum(CASE WHEN sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-01' AND DATE '2024-08-31' THEN gross_amount END) AS aug_sd,
       sum(CASE WHEN sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-09-01' AND DATE '2024-09-30' THEN gross_amount END) AS sep_sd,
       count(*) AS n
FROM lines GROUP BY 1,2,3,4 ORDER BY 1,2,3,4

SELECT f.sale_date >= DATE '2024-09-01' AS after_change, p.vat_class, f.vat_rate, count(*) AS n, sum(f.gross_amount) AS gross,
       min(f.sale_date) AS mn, max(f.sale_date) AS mx
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-01' AND DATE '2024-09-30'
GROUP BY 1,2,3 ORDER BY 1,2,3

WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered','collected')
),
mine AS (
    SELECT month(COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date)) AS m, s.store_id = 900 AS is_web, sum(f.net_amount) AS net_before_returns, count(DISTINCT f.receipt_id) AS receipts
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
      AND COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-01' AND DATE '2024-09-30'
    GROUP BY 1,2),
ctl AS (
    SELECT month(business_date) AS m, store_id = 900 AS is_web, sum(net_sales_before_returns) AS ctl_net, sum(receipts) AS ctl_receipts
    FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE business_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-01' AND DATE '2024-09-30' AND store_id <> 999
    GROUP BY 1,2)
SELECT * FROM mine FULL JOIN ctl USING (m, is_web) ORDER BY 1,2

WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id,
           CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order
    WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
gross_lines AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, s.region, f.gross_amount
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
)
SELECT region,
       SUM(CASE WHEN business_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-01' AND DATE '2024-08-31' THEN gross_amount ELSE 0 END) AS august_2024_gross_incl_vat,
       SUM(CASE WHEN business_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-09-01' AND DATE '2024-09-30' THEN gross_amount ELSE 0 END) AS september_2024_gross_incl_vat
FROM gross_lines
WHERE business_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-01' AND DATE '2024-09-30'
GROUP BY region
ORDER BY region
